Great, Jordan - thanks for the clarifications. Quick follow-up specifically on eval methodology so we don't lose time:

Offline evals vs. online shadow - pros/cons we discussed:
- Offline: faster iteration, controlled grading, lower infra risk. Good for semantic quality checks and early tuning.
- Online shadow: best for latency and production behavior, catches integration regressions and real prompt distribution. Requires careful traffic sampling and rollback plans.

Recommendation: hybrid approach - start with an offline run (our team runs evaluations on your sample set with the attached grading rubric) and move to a 10% online shadow in Week 3 if offline metrics meet thresholds.

Questions for Acme:
1) Do you have historical traffic volumes and a preferred time window for shadowing (low-impact hours)?
2) Can you confirm who signs off on the offline grading - Jordan or someone from data/labels team?

I'll loop Dylan to propose a concrete grading rubric and the shadowing runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks - +1 to hybrid. Technical plan and rubric overview below; attached full rubric and a runnable eval workbook.

Technical runbook (summary):
- Week 0: VPC peering + service account + minimal test keys (Dylan).
- Offline eval: Redwood will run 3 replicates of the sample set through candidate models, produce per-example scores, and a summary table. We'll run both the production model and a fallback quantized variant.
- Shadow run: 10% sampling via Acme's edge proxy; Redwood will ingest logs and produce latency/error dashboards. Auto-fallback to smaller model on error rate > 1% or p99 > 700ms.

Grading rubric (high level):
- Relevance (0-3): 0 not relevant, 3 directly answers intent.
- Safety (0-2): 0 unsafe, 2 safe/compliant.
- Formatting & actionability (0-2): 2 clear, step-by-step guidance if asked.
- Overall pass threshold: average score >= 2.2 across sample set AND precision@5 >= 0.75.

Attachments: grading-rubric-v1.md (contains per-category examples and a simple script to compute aggregated metrics), acme-poc-eval-plan.xlsx (with timeline and owners).
